'''Macoll''' is a Bannerman in the [[Band of the Red Hand]].

== Activities ==
[[Matrim Cauthon]] orders him to unfurl the banner, when the Seanchan force that is trying to kill [[Tuon Athaem Kore Paendrag]] for the one hundred thousand gold crown reward, comes charging towards the Band.
